locations.heading: Where We Cover
locations.subheading: 159 cities across 14 states — 24/7 dispatch, same-day response

items.question: How fast can you arrive?
items.answer: Within 4 hours for Klang Valley. Outer cities (Ipoh, Penang, Johor Bahru, Melaka) are under 8 hours. Truly urgent calls at midnight are usually dispatched within 90 minutes in KL.

items.question: Do you work at 2 AM?
items.answer: Yes. We run a 24/7 line with no surcharge before midnight. After midnight a small after-hours fee applies for full rewiring jobs only — emergency plug point or breaker resets stay at flat pricing.

items.question: Are your electricians certified?
items.answer: Every wireman is ST (Suruhanjaya Tenaga) registered. Ask on WhatsApp and we'll send you the electrician's registration number and photo ID before they arrive.

items.question: How do you charge?
items.answer: Fixed per-job pricing: plug point from RM80, ceiling fan install from RM150, downlight from RM60, water heater from RM150. Larger jobs (full rewiring, DB upgrade) are quoted on-site with written scope.

items.question: Do you serve apartments and condos?
items.answer: Yes — landed houses, condos, apartments, shoplots and factories. If your building requires a permit-to-work, we can usually arrange it on the same visit.

items.question: Do you warranty your work?
items.answer: 30-day workmanship warranty on every job. If the same fault returns within 30 days, we come back and refix it with no call-out fee.
